coverage.summary: Applies to all rental properties used for dwelling purposes, including mobile homes, except owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt.

result.notes: The existing coverage is supported by the DCA Truth in Renting guide (D067), the only document that discusses the reprisal law. I changed requires_unknown_facts from null to false: the rule covers ordinary rental dwellings generally, not a class of buildings that assessor data cannot identify. The guide gives no unit minimum, construction-date limit or local-preemption language, so those fields stay null.
